# opnsense_acmeclient_account (Data Source)

Retrieves an ACME Client account from the OPNsense os-acme-client plugin by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_acmeclient_account" "example" {
  id = "<uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACME account.

### Read-Only

- `account_key` (String, Sensitive) ACME account private key.
- `ca` (String) Certificate authority identifier.
- `custom_ca` (String) Custom ACME CA directory URL when `ca` is set to a custom value.
- `description` (String) Optional description for this ACME account.
- `eab_hmac` (String, Sensitive) External Account Binding (EAB) HMAC key.
- `eab_kid` (String) External Account Binding (EAB) key identifier.
- `email` (String) Contact email address registered with the ACME CA.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this ACME account is enabled.
- `name` (String) Display name for the ACME account.
- `status_code` (String) Last known ACME account status code from OPNsense.
- `status_last_update` (String) Timestamp of the last ACME account status update.
